Axiom: The SDD mechanical tools are `gennady` CLI commands. Invoke them as `npx tsx ~/Developer/gennady/cli/gennady.ts ` — this runs from source in the gennady repo, and is rewritten to `npx gennady ` by the path-normalizer when the directives are synced into a project. Tools: `sdd-state`, `sdd-task`, `sdd-extract`, `sdd-verify`, `sdd-log`, `sdd-sync`, `sdd-check`, `orient`. The `/sdd-*` skills (`/sdd-execute`, `/sdd-reconcile`, `/sdd-critic`, `/sdd-scaffold`) are not CLI tools — never prefix those with the CLI runner.
